# Job 23 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Job 23 (17 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 3

---

## V.2 — "my hand" vs. "his hand"
- **EMET:** "my-hand" (Ketiv *yadi*) / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "his hand" (emended *yado*)
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "his hand" — contextually stronger; the Ketiv is a known difficulty.

---

## V.8-9 — Hebrew directional idiom vs. compass directions
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "forward/backward/left/right" / **PNEUMA:** "east/west/north/south"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** Hebrew idiom retained — compass equivalents are interpretive.

---

## V.12 — "my portion" vs. "my daily bread"
- **EMET:** literal "my-portion" (*chuqi*) / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "my daily bread/food"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "daily bread" — clarifies the metaphor of allocated sustenance.

---
*— SOPHIA*
